locked_v9_reference.use: sole character identity reference; fixed V9 open-eye silhouette and nose anchor

purpose: Produce a more readable but still restrained four-emotion source sheet. This is source-only art; a later Rig may extract brows, mouths, and cheeks only.
identity_locks: Keep the exact V9 open eye body, scale, spacing, primary highlight, small sparkle, and centered nose.
No new eye shape, pupil, eyelid, eyelash, wink, face outline, color, gray, antialiasing, text, card, or UI.

emotion_contract.name: delighted
emotion_contract.mouth: one clearly wider open U-smile with a white interior

emotion_contract.name: bashful
emotion_contract.mouth: one tiny closed asymmetric shy smile, never a default W-mouth
emotion_contract.cheeks: two compact cheeks pulled visibly closer to the mouth

emotion_contract.name: thoughtful
emotion_contract.brows: left high arch and right low relaxed arc
emotion_contract.mouth: one small closed offset three-part pondering curve, never an O-mouth or surprise mouth
emotion_contract.cheeks: left cheek subtly lifted; right cheek low

emotion_contract.name: focused
emotion_contract.brows: two short low inward-sloping but rounded brows
emotion_contract.mouth: one compact almost-flat confident line with soft rounded ends, never a W-mouth or frown

separation_contract: Every pose must differ from every other pose in its brow pair, mouth silhouette, and cheek placement. The difference must remain apparent when rendered at native 200x200.
